# ============================================================ manhole placement (auto)
def place_manholes(item_id, segs):
    """Place manholes so first<=180ft from source, last<=180ft from dest, spacing<=380ft on straight runs;
    returns list of (x,y) positions along route."""
    info=ITEMS[item_id]; src=info['src']; dst=info['dst']
    # build cumulative polyline of underground methods only (CE/UE/DB); HDD/JB connect via manholes too
    pts=[]; cuts=[]  # cuts = (method, length)
    for s in segs:
        if s['method'] in ('CE','UE','DB','HDD','JB','JS'):
            for i,p in enumerate(s['pts']):
                if not pts or p!=pts[-1]:
                    pts.append(p)
    if not pts: return []
    # total length and parametrize
    L=plen(pts)
    # positions from source along pts
    def pos_at(d):
        acc=0
        for i in range(len(pts)-1):
            segL=dist(pts[i],pts[i+1])
            if acc+segL>=d:
                t=(d-acc)/segL
                return (pts[i][0]+t*(pts[i+1][0]-pts[i][0]), pts[i][1]+t*(pts[i+1][1]-pts[i][1]))
            acc+=segL
        return pts[-1]
    positions=[]
    first=150; last=180; spacing=380
    d=first
    while d<L-last:
        positions.append(pos_at(d)); d+=spacing
    return positions

def add(rows, code, qty, matcode=None, sub=0):
    if code in LU:
        mh,crew=lu_mh(code, large_string=(code=='STRING'))

        mh,crew=0.0,None

        crate=crew_avg_rate(crew); cer=crew_eq_rate(crew); csize=CREWS[crew][0]
        lab=mhr*crate; eq=(mhr/csize)*cer if csize else 0

    else:

    rows.append([code,qty,unit,mhr,lab,eq,mat,sub])

        elif m=='HDD':

    # manholes

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Build conveyance_study.xlsx + report for PCSFA 13.8 kV conveyance study.
Produces output/submission.zip with conveyance_study.xlsx and conveyance_study_report.md.
"""
import os, math, zipfile, datetime
from build_data import *

HERE=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
OUT=os.path.join(HERE,"output"); os.makedirs(OUT,exist_ok=True)

# ============================================================ geometry
def dist(p,q): return math.hypot(p[0]-q[0],p[1]-q[1])
def plen(pts): return sum(dist(pts[i],pts[i+1]) for i in range(len(pts)-1))
def midpt(s): return ((s['pts'][0][0]+s['pts'][-1][0])/2,(s['pts'][0][1]+s['pts'][-1][1])/2)

# ============================================================ items
# item: src,dst (site ft), I (design current A), lf(%), fk (fault kA @0.5s), terminals(type)
ITEMS={
 'C01':dict(src=(280,640),dst=(1100,730),I=640,lf=100,fk=16.5),
 'C02':dict(src=(280,520),dst=(1330,420),I=560,lf=100,fk=16.5),
 'C03':dict(src=(240,700),dst=(470,960), I=400,lf=75, fk=16.5),
 'C04':dict(src=(600,1020),dst=(1760,1152),I=60,lf=75,fk=14.2),
 'C05':dict(src=(1132,732),dst=(1442,642),I=200,lf=75,fk=15.8),
 'C06':dict(src=(180,480),dst=(1800,122),I=40,lf=75,fk=16.5),
 'C07':dict(src=(470,1060),dst=(1030,1172),I=120,lf=75,fk=14.2),
}
ORDER=['1/0','2/0','4/0','250','350','500','750','1000']
def sc_min(fk):
    for s in ORDER:
        if SC_05[s]>=fk: return s
    return '1000'
def kcmil(s): return {'1/0':105.6,'2/0':133.1,'4/0':211.6,'250':250,'350':350,'500':500,'750':750,'1000':1000}[s]

# ============================================================ ampacity helpers
def amp_ductbank(size,circ,rho,lf,depth_in,amb=25):
    rho=next_rho(rho)
    base=DB_AMP.get((size,circ,rho,lf))
    if base is None: return None
    d=next_depth_tab(depth_in)
    dc=DEPTH_CORR[size].get(str(d),1.0)
    ac=AMB_CORR[size].get(str(amb),1.0)
    return base*dc*ac
def amp_single(size,rho,depth_in,lf,amb=25):
    rho=next_rho(rho); d=next_depth_tab(depth_in)
    base=SC_AMP.get((size,rho,d,lf))
    if base is None: return None
    return base*AMB_CORR[size].get(str(amb),1.0)
def amp_dburial(size,rho,lf,amb=25):
    rho=next_rho(rho); base=DBR_AMP.get((size,rho,lf))
    if base is None: return None
    return base*AMB_CORR[size].get(str(amb),1.0)
def amp_air(size,install,amb=40): return AIR_AMP.get((size,install,amb))
def amp_acsr(size,amb=40): return ACSR_AMP[size][str(amb)]

# ============================================================ cable sizing (size,sets,ampacity_per_set)
def size_cable(item_id, ampfn, scsize):
    I=ITEMS[item_id]['I']; best=None
    for sets in range(1,5):
        for si in range(ORDER.index(scsize),len(ORDER)):
            s=ORDER[si]; amp=ampfn(s,sets)
            if amp is None: continue
            if sets*amp>=I:
                key=sets*CABLE[s][2]
                if best is None or key<best[0]: best=(key,(s,sets,amp))
    if best is None:
        s='1000'; return s,3,ampfn(s,3)
    return best[1]

# ============================================================ routes (recommended)
def S(method,pts,cover=24,rows=1,cols=1,ductsize='EB20-5',spares=1,reinforced=False,paved=False,shared=None):
    return dict(method=method,pts=pts,cover=cover,rows=rows,cols=cols,ductsize=ductsize,
                spares=spares,reinforced=reinforced,paved=paved,shared=shared or set())
def spares_rule(n_occ):
    # UFC 3-550-01 3-11.2.2: at least 1/3 of ductbank empty (spares/(occ+spares)>=1/3), min 1
    s=1
    while s/(n_occ+s) < 1.0/3.0: s+=1
    return s

# proto-route legs: (method, pts, cover, ductsize) -- cols set after sizing
LEGS={
 'C01':[('CE',[(280,640),(710,640)],24,'EB20-5'),('HDD',[(710,640),(840,640)],48,'HDPE-5'),('CE',[(840,640),(1085,640)],24,'EB20-5'),('CE',[(1085,640),(1085,730),(1100,730)],24,'EB20-5')],
 'C02':[('CE',[(280,520),(710,520)],24,'EB20-5'),('HDD',[(710,520),(840,520)],48,'HDPE-5'),('CE',[(840,520),(840,445)],24,'EB20-5'),('CE',[(840,445),(840,415)],54,'EB20-5'),('CE',[(840,415),(1330,420)],24,'EB20-5')],
 'C03':[('CE',[(240,700),(470,700)],24,'EB20-5'),('CE',[(470,700),(470,895)],24,'EB20-5'),('CE',[(470,895),(470,945)],52,'EB20-5'),('CE',[(470,945),(470,960)],24,'EB20-5')],
 'C04':[('CE',[(600,1020),(1550,1020)],24,'EB20-5'),('HDD',[(1550,1020),(1690,1020)],120,'HDPE-5'),('CE',[(1690,1020),(1690,1152),(1760,1152)],24,'EB20-5')],
 'C06':[('CE',[(180,480),(180,200)],24,'EB20-5'),('HDD',[(180,200),(180,90)],48,'HDPE-5'),('CE',[(180,90),(710,90)],24,'EB20-5'),('HDD',[(710,90),(840,90)],48,'HDPE-5'),('CE',[(840,90),(1800,90)],24,'EB20-5'),('CE',[(1800,90),(1800,122)],24,'EB20-5')],
 'C07':[('CE',[(470,1060),(470,1075),(710,1075)],24,'EB20-5'),('HDD',[(710,1075),(840,1075)],48,'HDPE-5'),('CE',[(840,1075),(1030,1075),(1030,1172)],24,'EB20-5')],
}
def build_segs(iid,sets):
    out=[]
    for m,pts,cover,ds in LEGS[iid]:
        if m in ('CE','UE'):
            out.append(S(m,pts,cover=cover,cols=sets+spares_rule(sets),ductsize=ds,spares=spares_rule(sets)))
        elif m=='HDD':
            out.append(S(m,pts,cover=cover,cols=sets,ductsize=ds,spares=0))
        else:
            out.append(S(m,pts,cover=cover,cols=sets,ductsize=ds))
    return out
def gov_amp(iid,size,sets):
    info=ITEMS[iid]; legs=LEGS[iid]
    ug=sum(plen(p) for m,p,c,d in legs if m in('CE','UE','DB','HDD','JB','JS'))
    bore=sum(plen(p) for m,p,c,d in legs if m in('HDD','JB','JS'))
    amps=[]
    for m,p,c,d in legs:
        mx=(p[0][0]+p[-1][0])/2; my=(p[0][1]+p[-1][1])/2
        b=nearest_boring(mx,my); rho=next_rho(boring_rho(b))
        if m in('CE','UE'): amp=amp_ductbank(size,sets,rho,info['lf'],c,25)
        elif m in('HDD','JB','JS'):
            if (bore/ug if ug else 1)<=0.25: continue
            amp=amp_single(size,rho,c,info['lf'],25)
        else: amp=None
        if amp: amps.append(amp)
    return min(amps) if amps else None

ROUTES={
 'C01':('CEDB',None),'C02':('CEDB',None),'C03':('CEDB',None),'C04':('CEDB',None),
 'C05':('RMC',[dict(method='RMC',pts=[(1132,732),(1132,705),(1442,705),(1442,642)],riser=7,bends=2,firewalls=2)]),
 'C06':('CEDB',None),'C07':('CEDB',None),
}
# OH route for C06 (alternative)
C06_OH=dict(ug=[S('CE',[(180,480),(180,290)],cols=2),S('CE',[(1790,200),(1800,122)],cols=2)],
            oh_pts=[(180,290),(1790,200)],poles=[(180,290),(1790,200)],riser=[(180,290),(1790,200)],conductor='ACSR-1/0',pole_50=[(180,290)])

# ============================================================ manhole placement (auto)
def place_manholes(item_id, segs):
    """Place manholes so first<=180ft from source, last<=180ft from dest, spacing<=380ft on straight runs;
    returns list of (x,y) positions along route."""
    info=ITEMS[item_id]; src=info['src']; dst=info['dst']
    # build cumulative polyline of underground methods only (CE/UE/DB); HDD/JB connect via manholes too
    pts=[]; cuts=[]  # cuts = (method, length)
    for s in segs:
        if s['method'] in ('CE','UE','DB','HDD','JB','JS'):
            for i,p in enumerate(s['pts']):
                if not pts or p!=pts[-1]:
                    pts.append(p)
    if not pts: return []
    # total length and parametrize
    L=plen(pts)
    # positions from source along pts
    def pos_at(d):
        acc=0
        for i in range(len(pts)-1):
            segL=dist(pts[i],pts[i+1])
            if acc+segL>=d:
                t=(d-acc)/segL
                return (pts[i][0]+t*(pts[i+1][0]-pts[i][0]), pts[i][1]+t*(pts[i+1][1]-pts[i][1]))
            acc+=segL
        return pts[-1]
    positions=[]
    first=150; last=180; spacing=380
    d=first
    while d<L-last:
        positions.append(pos_at(d)); d+=spacing
    return positions

# ============================================================ takeoff engine (site)
def add(rows, code, qty, matcode=None, sub=0):
    if code in LU:
        mh,crew=lu_mh(code, large_string=(code=='STRING'))
    else:
        mh,crew=0.0,None
    mhr=mh*qty
    if crew:
        crate=crew_avg_rate(crew); cer=crew_eq_rate(crew); csize=CREWS[crew][0]
        lab=mhr*crate; eq=(mhr/csize)*cer if csize else 0
        unit=LU[code][1]
    else:
        lab=0; eq=0; unit=MAT[code][1] if code in MAT else 'EA'
    mat=mat_unit(matcode)*qty if (matcode and qty and qty>0) else 0
    rows.append([code,qty,unit,mhr,lab,eq,mat,sub])

def takeoff_site(item_id, ctype, segs, size, sets, oh=None, n_mh=None):
    info=ITEMS[item_id]; rows=[]
    ug_len=sum(plen(s['pts']) for s in segs if s['method'] in ('CE','UE','DB','HDD','JB','JS'))
    n_equip=2
    for s in segs:
        L=plen(s['pts']); m=s['method']; cols=s['cols']; rows_n=s['rows']; ducts=cols*rows_n
        od=COND[s['ductsize']][0]
        if m in ('CE','UE'):
            ew=cols*od+(cols-1)*3+(6 if m=='CE' else 0)
            eh=rows_n*od+(rows_n-1)*3+(6 if m=='CE' else 0)
            botw=ew+12; dep_in=s['cover']+eh+3; dep_ft=dep_in/12.0
            b=nearest_boring(*midpt(s)); st=soil_type(b,dep_ft); sl=SLOPE[st]
            if dep_ft>=5:
                avgw=botw+sl*dep_in; exc_cf=(avgw/12.0)*dep_ft*L
                prot='slope'
            else:
                exc_cf=(botw/12.0)*dep_ft*L; prot='none'
            add(rows,'EX-MACH',exc_cf/27.0)
            duct_area=ducts*(math.pi/4.0)*(od/12.0)**2*L
            if m=='CE':
                conc_cy=((ew/12.0)*(eh/12.0)*L-duct_area)/27.0
                add(rows,'CONC-PL',conc_cy,'CONC-3000')
            else:
                sand_cf=(botw/12.0)*((eh+9)/12.0)*L-duct_area
                add(rows,'SAND-BED',sand_cf/27.0,'SAND')
            env_cf=(ew/12.0)*(eh/12.0)*L
            if m=='CE':
                bf=exc_cf/27.0-(env_cf-duct_area)/27.0
            else:
                sand_cf=(botw/12.0)*((eh+9)/12.0)*L-duct_area
                bf=exc_cf/27.0-duct_area/27.0-sand_cf/27.0
            if bf>0: add(rows,'BF-COMP',bf)
            matcode='EB20-5' if s['ductsize']=='HDPE-5' else s['ductsize']
            add(rows,'DUCT-CE' if m=='CE' else 'DUCT-UE', ducts*L, matcode)
            add(rows,'SPACER', ducts*(int(L//5)+1),'SPACER')
            if m=='CE' and s['reinforced']:
                nb=6 if ew>30 else 4
                rebar=nb*0.668*L+(int(L//3)+1)*((2*(ew-3)+2*(eh-3))/12.0)*0.376
                add(rows,'REBAR',rebar,'REBAR-4')
            add(rows,'GND-DB',L,'GND-4/0'); add(rows,'TAPE',L,'TAPE-DET')
            if s['paved']:
                topw=botw+(2*sl*dep_in if dep_ft>=5 else 0)
                add(rows,'PAVE-CUT',L*(topw/12.0+2)/9.0,'ASPHALT')
            gwt=boring_gw_ft(b)
            if dep_ft>gwt and gwt<15: add(rows,'DEWATER',L)
        elif m=='DB':
            ch=2.155*CABLE[size][0]; botw=8; dep_in=s['cover']+ch+3; dep_ft=dep_in/12.0
            b=nearest_boring(*midpt(s)); st=soil_type(b,dep_ft); sl=SLOPE[st]
            add(rows,'EX-TRCH',L)
            sand_cf=(botw/12.0)*((ch+6)/12.0)*L
            add(rows,'SAND-BED',sand_cf/27.0,'SAND')
            if dep_ft>=5: exc_cf=(botw/12.0+sl*dep_ft)*dep_ft*L
            else: exc_cf=(botw/12.0)*dep_ft*L
            bf=exc_cf/27.0-sand_cf/27.0
            if bf>0: add(rows,'BF-COMP',bf)
            add(rows,'GND-DB',L,'GND-4/0'); add(rows,'TAPE',L,'TAPE-DET')
            gwt=boring_gw_ft(b)
            if dep_ft>gwt and gwt<15: add(rows,'DEWATER',L)
        elif m=='HDD':
            ncond=cols*s['rows']; per={2:64.0,4:92.0,6:128.0}.get(ncond,128.0)
            ft=per*L; sub=ft+5400.0
            if s['cover']>96: sub+=0.15*ft
            sub=max(sub,14000.0)
            rows.append(['SUB-HDD',1,'EA',0,0,0,0,sub])
        elif m=='JB':
            ncond=cols*s['rows']; sub=295.0*L+(ncond-1)*88.0*L+6800.0
            rows.append(['SUB-JB',1,'EA',0,0,0,0,sub])
            rows.append(['RGS-5',ncond*L,'LF',0,0,0,mat_unit('RGS-5')*ncond*L,0])
        elif m=='JS':
            ncond=cols*s['rows']; sub=540.0*L+ncond*36.0*L+9800.0
            rows.append(['SUB-JS',1,'EA',0,0,0,0,sub])
            rows.append(['RGS-5',ncond*L,'LF',0,0,0,mat_unit('RGS-5')*ncond*L,0])
    # manholes
    if n_mh is None: n_mh=len(place_manholes(item_id,segs))
    for _ in range(n_mh):
        bw=7.33+4; bl=9.33+4; exc_cy=bw*bl*8/27.0
        add(rows,'EX-MACH',exc_cy)
        rock=bw*bl*0.5/27.0; add(rows,'MH-BASE',rock,'ROCK-BASE')
        bf=exc_cy-(7.33*9.33*7)/27.0-rock
        if bf>0: add(rows,'BF-COMP',bf)
        add(rows,'MH-SET',1,'MH-PRECAST'); add(rows,'TBOX',20)
    # cable
    ckt=sets*(ug_len+6*n_mh+18*n_equip)
    pullcode='PULL-MV-L' if kcmil(size)>=250 else 'PULL-MV'
    if ctype=='DBC':
        dbl=sum(plen(s['pts']) for s in segs if s['method']=='DB'); rest=ug_len-dbl
        add(rows,'DBC-LAY',sets*(dbl+6*n_mh+18*n_equip))
        if rest>0: add(rows,pullcode,sets*rest)
    else:
        add(rows,pullcode,ckt)
    add(rows,'CBL-'+size,3*ckt,'CBL-'+size)
    add(rows,'TERM-MV',3*sets*n_equip,'TERM-KIT')
    if n_mh>0: add(rows,'FIREPROOF',12*3*sets*n_mh,'FIRETAPE')
    # overhead
    if oh:
        Loh=plen(oh['oh_pts']); np=len(oh['poles']); nr=len(oh['riser'])
        add(rows,'POLE-SET',np,'POLE-50' if oh['pole_50'] else 'POLE-45')
        add(rows,'POLE-HOLE',np)
        add(rows,'XARM',np+nr,'XARM-ASSY')
        add(rows,'GUY',nr,'GUY-ASSY')   # riser poles 1 guy each (dead-end 1)
        add(rows,'RISER',nr,'RISER-ASSY')
        add(rows,'STRING',3*Loh*1.015, oh['conductor'])
    return rows, n_mh

# ============================================================ takeoff C05 (building)
def takeoff_c05(ctype, size, sets):
    info=ITEMS['C05']; rows=[]
    # plan route length along corridor (1132->1442 = 310 ft horizontal), plus 2 rises 7ft each
    L=dist((1132,705),(1442,705))  # 310 ft
    rises=2; rise_h=7
    n_equip=2  # MSG-A and USS-A1 (both gear)
    if ctype=='RMC' or ctype=='EMT':
        cond_code='RMC-5' if ctype=='RMC' else 'EMT-4'
        mat_code='RGS-5' if ctype=='RMC' else 'EMT-4IN'
        cond_LF=sets*(L+2*rises)
        add(rows,cond_code,cond_LF,mat_code)
        # elbows: sets x (bends + 2); bends=2 (the 2 corner bends of the route)
        bends=2
        add(rows,'ELBOW-5',sets*(bends+2),'ELBOW-RGS5')
        # firestop per set per rated wall (2 rated walls: ER-A 2hr, MR-1 2hr; plus 1-hr corridor walls)
        n_rated_walls=4  # ER-A entry(2hr), MR-1 entry(2hr), 2 corridor 1-hr walls
        for _ in range(n_rated_walls):
            add(rows,'FIRE-RMC',sets,'FIRESTOP-RMC5')
        # cable circuit-ft = sets x (route + 2 rises + 2x10)
        ckt=sets*(L+2*rises+2*10)
        add(rows,'PULL-IN',ckt)
        add(rows,'CBL-'+size,3*ckt,'CBL-'+size)
        add(rows,'TERM-IN',6*sets,'TERM-KIT')   # 6 per set
        # seismic braces ceil(L/40)+ceil(L/80)
        add(rows,'SEISMIC',math.ceil(L/40)+math.ceil(L/80),'SEISMIC-BR')
    else:  # TRAY-EN or TRAY-LD
        tray_code='TRAY-24'; tray_mat='TRAY-24-SB' if ctype=='TRAY-EN' else 'TRAY-24-LD'
        add(rows,tray_code,L,tray_mat)
        if ctype=='TRAY-EN':
            add(rows,'TRAY-COV',L,'TRAY-COV-24')  # enclosed cover
        add(rows,'TRAY-BOND',L,'BOND-2')
        # RMC drops sets x 2 rises with 2 elbows per set
        add(rows,'RMC-5',sets*2*rises,'RGS-5')
        add(rows,'ELBOW-5',sets*2*2,'ELBOW-RGS5')
        # sleeves per 2-hour wall (2), firestop per set per 1-hour wall (2)
        add(rows,'FIRE-SLV',2,'FIRE-SLV-4')  # 2 two-hour walls
        for _ in range(2): add(rows,'FIRE-RMC',sets,'FIRESTOP-RMC5')
        add(rows,'SEISMIC',math.ceil(L/40)+math.ceil(L/80),'SEISMIC-BR')
        ckt=sets*(L+2*rises+2*10)
        add(rows,'PULL-IN',ckt)
        add(rows,'CBL-'+size,3*ckt,'CBL-'+size)
        add(rows,'TERM-IN',6*sets,'TERM-KIT')
    return rows

# ============================================================ cost roll-up (per-alternative direct cost)
def direct_cost(rows):
    lab=sum(r[4] for r in rows); eq=sum(r[5] for r in rows); mat=sum(r[6] for r in rows); sub=sum(r[7] for r in rows)
    mh=sum(r[3] for r in rows)
    return mh,lab,eq,mat,sub

# bond effective rate from sum of recommended (direct+JOOH+HOOH+profit)
BOND_EFF={'rate':0.0}
def bond_premium(S):
    p=0.0
    for lo,hi,rate in [(0,100000,0.025),(100000,400000,0.015),(400000,2000000,0.010),(2000000,2500000,0.0075),(2500000,1e18,0.0065)]:
        if S>lo:
            p+=rate*(min(S,hi)-lo)
    return p*(1+BOND_SURCHARGE)
def compute_bond_eff(recos):
    S=sum(r['direct']*ACF*(1+JOOH_PCT)*(1+HOOH_PCT)*(1+PROFIT_PCT) for r in recos)
    prem=bond_premium(S)
    BOND_EFF['rate']=prem/S if S>0 else 0.0

# ============================================================ admissibility
# site items: CEDB Y; UEDB N (IEDS 4.2); DBC N (IEDS 4.2); HDD N (entire run - IEDS 4.3 bores only crossings); OH depends
SITE_ADM={
 'C01':{'CEDB':'Y','UEDB':'N','DBC':'N','HDD':'N','OH':'N'},
 'C02':{'CEDB':'Y','UEDB':'N','DBC':'N','HDD':'N','OH':'N'},
 'C03':{'CEDB':'Y','UEDB':'N','DBC':'N','HDD':'N','OH':'N'},
 'C04':{'CEDB':'Y','UEDB':'N','DBC':'N','HDD':'N','OH':'N'},
 'C06':{'CEDB':'Y','UEDB':'N','DBC':'N','HDD':'N','OH':'Y'},
 'C07':{'CEDB':'Y','UEDB':'N','DBC':'N','HDD':'N','OH':'N'},
}
C05_ADM={'RMC':'Y','EMT':'Y','TRAY-EN':'N','TRAY-LD':'N'}
CLAUSE={
 'CEDB':'IEDS 4.2; UFC 3-550-01 3-11.2.1',
 'UEDB':'IEDS 4.2 (conduit without encasement not permitted for primary distribution)',
 'DBC':'IEDS 4.2 (direct-buried cable not permitted for primary distribution)',
 'HDD':'IEDS 4.3 (directional bores only for crossings, not entire run)',
 'OH':'IEDS 4.1 (overhead not permitted inside congested industrial area / W-3 crane area)',
 'RMC':'IEDS 5.1; UFC 3-520-01 Table 3-1; UFGS 26 20 00 3.1.6',
 'EMT':'IEDS 5.1; UFC 3-520-01 Table 3-1 (EMT permitted for MV where listed)',
 'TRAY-EN':'IEDS 5.1 (no viable route: 14/16-in spaces block; SCIF keepout blocks detour)',
 'TRAY-LD':'IEDS 5.1 (no viable route: 14/16-in spaces block; SCIF keepout blocks detour)',
}

# ============================================================ build alternatives
ALTS=[]   # list of dict per (item,type)
TAKE=[]   # takeoff rows
RECO=[]   # recommended summary
for iid in ['C01','C02','C03','C04','C05','C06','C07']:
    info=ITEMS[iid]
    if iid=='C05':

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Build conveyance_study.xlsx + report for PCSFA 13.8 kV conveyance study.
Produces output/submission.zip with conveyance_study.xlsx and conveyance_study_report.md.
"""
import os, math, zipfile, datetime
from build_data import *

HERE=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
OUT=os.path.join(HERE,"output"); os.makedirs(OUT,exist_ok=True)

# ============================================================ geometry
def dist(p,q): return math.hypot(p[0]-q[0],p[1]-q[1])
def plen(pts): return sum(dist(pts[i],pts[i+1]) for i in range(len(pts)-1))
def midpt(s): return ((s['pts'][0][0]+s['pts'][-1][0])/2,(s['pts'][0][1]+s['pts'][-1][1])/2)

# ============================================================ items
# item: src,dst (site ft), I (design current A), lf(%), fk (fault kA @0.5s), terminals(type)
ITEMS={
 'C01':dict(src=(280,640),dst=(1100,730),I=640,lf=100,fk=16.5),
 'C02':dict(src=(280,520),dst=(1330,420),I=560,lf=100,fk=16.5),
 'C03':dict(src=(240,700),dst=(470,960), I=400,lf=75, fk=16.5),
 'C04':dict(src=(600,1020),dst=(1760,1152),I=60,lf=75,fk=14.2),
 'C05':dict(src=(1132,732),dst=(1442,642),I=200,lf=75,fk=15.8),
 'C06':dict(src=(180,480),dst=(1800,122),I=40,lf=75,fk=16.5),
 'C07':dict(src=(470,1060),dst=(1030,1172),I=120,lf=75,fk=14.2),
}
ORDER=['1/0','2/0','4/0','250','350','500','750','1000']
def sc_min(fk):
    for s in ORDER:
        if SC_05[s]>=fk: return s
    return '1000'
def kcmil(s): return {'1/0':105.6,'2/0':133.1,'4/0':211.6,'250':250,'350':350,'500':500,'750':750,'1000':1000}[s]

# ============================================================ ampacity helpers
def amp_ductbank(size,circ,rho,lf,depth_in,amb=25):
    rho=next_rho(rho)
    base=DB_AMP.get((size,circ,rho,lf))
    if base is None: return None
    d=next_depth_tab(depth_in)
    dc=DEPTH_CORR[size].get(str(d),1.0)
    ac=AMB_CORR[size].get(str(amb),1.0)
    return base*dc*ac
def amp_single(size,rho,depth_in,lf,amb=25):
    rho=next_rho(rho); d=next_depth_tab(depth_in)
    base=SC_AMP.get((size,rho,d,lf))
    if base is None: return None
    return base*AMB_CORR[size].get(str(amb),1.0)
def amp_dburial(size,rho,lf,amb=25):
    rho=next_rho(rho); base=DBR_AMP.get((size,rho,lf))
    if base is None: return None
    return base*AMB_CORR[size].get(str(amb),1.0)
def amp_air(size,install,amb=40): return AIR_AMP.get((size,install,amb))
def amp_acsr(size,amb=40): return ACSR_AMP[size][str(amb)]

# ============================================================ cable sizing (size,sets,ampacity_per_set)
def size_cable(item_id, ampfn, scsize):
    I=ITEMS[item_id]['I']; best=None
    for sets in range(1,5):
        for si in range(ORDER.index(scsize),len(ORDER)):
            s=ORDER[si]; amp=ampfn(s,sets)
            if amp is None: continue
            if sets*amp>=I:
                key=sets*CABLE[s][2]
                if best is None or key<best[0]: best=(key,(s,sets,amp))
    if best is None:
        s='1000'; return s,3,ampfn(s,3)
    return best[1]

# ============================================================ routes (recommended)
def S(method,pts,cover=24,rows=1,cols=1,ductsize='EB20-5',spares=1,reinforced=False,paved=False,shared=None):
    return dict(method=method,pts=pts,cover=cover,rows=rows,cols=cols,ductsize=ductsize,
                spares=spares,reinforced=reinforced,paved=paved,shared=shared or set())
def spares_rule(n_occ):
    # UFC 3-550-01 3-11.2.2: at least 1/3 of ductbank empty (spares/(occ+spares)>=1/3), min 1
    s=1
    while s/(n_occ+s) < 1.0/3.0: s+=1
    return s

# proto-route legs: (method, pts, cover, ductsize) -- cols set after sizing
LEGS={
 'C01':[('CE',[(280,640),(340,640),(340,620),(710,620)],24,'EB20-5'),('HDD',[(710,620),(840,620)],48,'HDPE-5'),('CE',[(840,620),(1090,620)],24,'EB20-5'),('CE',[(1090,620),(1090,730),(1100,730)],24,'EB20-5')],
 'C02':[('CE',[(280,520),(340,520),(340,545),(710,545)],24,'EB20-5'),('HDD',[(710,545),(840,545)],48,'HDPE-5'),('CE',[(840,545),(840,445)],24,'EB20-5'),('CE',[(840,445),(840,415)],54,'EB20-5'),('CE',[(840,415),(1330,420)],24,'EB20-5')],
 'C03':[('CE',[(240,700),(470,700)],24,'EB20-5'),('CE',[(470,700),(470,895)],24,'EB20-5'),('CE',[(470,895),(470,945)],52,'EB20-5'),('CE',[(470,945),(470,960)],24,'EB20-5')],
 'C04':[('CE',[(600,1020),(620,1020),(620,1000),(1550,1000)],24,'EB20-5'),('HDD',[(1550,1000),(1690,1000)],120,'HDPE-5'),('CE',[(1690,1000),(1690,1152),(1760,1152)],24,'EB20-5')],
 'C06':[('CE',[(180,480),(195,480),(195,110),(710,110)],24,'EB20-5'),('HDD',[(710,110),(840,110)],48,'HDPE-5'),('CE',[(840,110),(1800,110),(1800,122)],24,'EB20-5')],
 'C07':[('CE',[(470,1060),(470,1075),(710,1075)],24,'EB20-5'),('HDD',[(710,1075),(840,1075)],48,'HDPE-5'),('CE',[(840,1075),(1030,1075),(1030,1172)],24,'EB20-5')],
}
def build_segs(iid,sets):
    out=[]
    for m,pts,cover,ds in LEGS[iid]:
        if m in ('CE','UE'):
            out.append(S(m,pts,cover=cover,cols=sets+spares_rule(sets),ductsize=ds,spares=spares_rule(sets)))
        elif m=='HDD':
            out.append(S(m,pts,cover=cover,cols=sets,ductsize=ds,spares=0))
        else:
            out.append(S(m,pts,cover=cover,cols=sets,ductsize=ds))
    return out
def gov_amp(iid,size,sets):
    info=ITEMS[iid]; legs=LEGS[iid]
    ug=sum(plen(p) for m,p,c,d in legs if m in('CE','UE','DB','HDD','JB','JS'))
    bore=sum(plen(p) for m,p,c,d in legs if m in('HDD','JB','JS'))
    amps=[]
    for m,p,c,d in legs:
        mx=(p[0][0]+p[-1][0])/2; my=(p[0][1]+p[-1][1])/2
        b=nearest_boring(mx,my); rho=next_rho(boring_rho(b))
        if m in('CE','UE'): amp=amp_ductbank(size,sets,rho,info['lf'],c,25)
        elif m in('HDD','JB','JS'):
            if (bore/ug if ug else 1)<=0.25: continue
            amp=amp_single(size,rho,c,info['lf'],25)
        else: amp=None
        if amp: amps.append(amp)
    return min(amps) if amps else None

ROUTES={
 'C01':('CEDB',None),'C02':('CEDB',None),'C03':('CEDB',None),'C04':('CEDB',None),
 'C05':('RMC',[dict(method='RMC',pts=[(1132,732),(1132,705),(1442,705),(1442,642)],riser=7,bends=2,firewalls=2)]),
 'C06':('CEDB',None),'C07':('CEDB',None),
}
# OH route for C06 (alternative)
C06_OH=dict(ug=[S('CE',[(180,480),(180,290)],cols=2),S('CE',[(1790,200),(1800,122)],cols=2)],
            oh_pts=[(180,290),(1790,200)],poles=[(180,290),(1790,200)],riser=[(180,290),(1790,200)],conductor='ACSR-1/0',pole_50=[(180,290)])

# ============================================================ manhole placement (auto)
def place_manholes(item_id, segs):
    """Place manholes so first<=180ft from source, last<=180ft from dest, spacing<=380ft on straight runs;
    returns list of (x,y) positions along route."""
    info=ITEMS[item_id]; src=info['src']; dst=info['dst']
    # build cumulative polyline of underground methods only (CE/UE/DB); HDD/JB connect via manholes too
    pts=[]; cuts=[]  # cuts = (method, length)
    for s in segs:
        if s['method'] in ('CE','UE','DB','HDD','JB','JS'):
            for i,p in enumerate(s['pts']):
                if not pts or p!=pts[-1]:
                    pts.append(p)
    if not pts: return []
    # total length and parametrize
    L=plen(pts)
    # positions from source along pts
    def pos_at(d):
        acc=0
        for i in range(len(pts)-1):
            segL=dist(pts[i],pts[i+1])
            if acc+segL>=d:
                t=(d-acc)/segL
                return (pts[i][0]+t*(pts[i+1][0]-pts[i][0]), pts[i][1]+t*(pts[i+1][1]-pts[i][1]))
            acc+=segL
        return pts[-1]
    positions=[]
    first=150; last=180; spacing=380
    d=first
    while d<L-last:
        positions.append(pos_at(d)); d+=spacing
    return positions

# ============================================================ takeoff engine (site)
def add(rows, code, qty, matcode=None, sub=0):
    if code in LU:
        mh,crew=lu_mh(code, large_string=(code=='STRING'))
    else:
        mh,crew=0.0,None
    mhr=mh*qty
    if crew:
        crate=crew_avg_rate(crew); cer=crew_eq_rate(crew); csize=CREWS[crew][0]
        lab=mhr*crate; eq=(mhr/csize)*cer if csize else 0
        unit=LU[code][1]
    else:
        lab=0; eq=0; unit=MAT[code][1] if code in MAT else 'EA'
    mat=mat_unit(matcode)*qty if (matcode and qty and qty>0) else 0
    rows.append([code,qty,unit,mhr,lab,eq,mat,sub])

def takeoff_site(item_id, ctype, segs, size, sets, oh=None, n_mh=None):
    info=ITEMS[item_id]; rows=[]
    ug_len=sum(plen(s['pts']) for s in segs if s['method'] in ('CE','UE','DB','HDD','JB','JS'))
    n_equip=2
    for s in segs:
        L=plen(s['pts']); m=s['method']; cols=s['cols']; rows_n=s['rows']; ducts=cols*rows_n
        od=COND[s['ductsize']][0]
        if m in ('CE','UE'):
            ew=cols*od+(cols-1)*3+(6 if m=='CE' else 0)
            eh=rows_n*od+(rows_n-1)*3+(6 if m=='CE' else 0)
            botw=ew+12; dep_in=s['cover']+eh+3; dep_ft=dep_in/12.0
            b=nearest_boring(*midpt(s)); st=soil_type(b,dep_ft); sl=SLOPE[st]
            if dep_ft>=5:
                avgw=botw+sl*dep_in; exc_cf=(avgw/12.0)*dep_ft*L
                prot='slope'
            else:
                exc_cf=(botw/12.0)*dep_ft*L; prot='none'
            add(rows,'EX-MACH',exc_cf/27.0)
            duct_area=ducts*(math.pi/4.0)*(od/12.0)**2*L
            if m=='CE':
                conc_cy=((ew/12.0)*(eh/12.0)*L-duct_area)/27.0
                add(rows,'CONC-PL',conc_cy,'CONC-3000')
            else:
                sand_cf=(botw/12.0)*((eh+9)/12.0)*L-duct_area
                add(rows,'SAND-BED',sand_cf/27.0,'SAND')
            env_cf=(ew/12.0)*(eh/12.0)*L
            if m=='CE':
                bf=exc_cf/27.0-(env_cf-duct_area)/27.0
            else:
                sand_cf=(botw/12.0)*((eh+9)/12.0)*L-duct_area
                bf=exc_cf/27.0-duct_area/27.0-sand_cf/27.0
            if bf>0: add(rows,'BF-COMP',bf)
            matcode='EB20-5' if s['ductsize']=='HDPE-5' else s['ductsize']
            add(rows,'DUCT-CE' if m=='CE' else 'DUCT-UE', ducts*L, matcode)
            add(rows,'SPACER', ducts*(int(L//5)+1),'SPACER')
            if m=='CE' and s['reinforced']:
                nb=6 if ew>30 else 4
                rebar=nb*0.668*L+(int(L//3)+1)*((2*(ew-3)+2*(eh-3))/12.0)*0.376
                add(rows,'REBAR',rebar,'REBAR-4')
            add(rows,'GND-DB',L,'GND-4/0'); add(rows,'TAPE',L,'TAPE-DET')
            if s['paved']:
                topw=botw+(2*sl*dep_in if dep_ft>=5 else 0)
                add(rows,'PAVE-CUT',L*(topw/12.0+2)/9.0,'ASPHALT')
            gwt=boring_gw_ft(b)
            if dep_ft>gwt and gwt<15: add(rows,'DEWATER',L)
        elif m=='DB':
            ch=2.155*CABLE[size][0]; botw=8; dep_in=s['cover']+ch+3; dep_ft=dep_in/12.0
            b=nearest_boring(*midpt(s)); st=soil_type(b,dep_ft); sl=SLOPE[st]
            add(rows,'EX-TRCH',L)
            sand_cf=(botw/12.0)*((ch+6)/12.0)*L
            add(rows,'SAND-BED',sand_cf/27.0,'SAND')
            if dep_ft>=5: exc_cf=(botw/12.0+sl*dep_ft)*dep_ft*L
            else: exc_cf=(botw/12.0)*dep_ft*L
            bf=exc_cf/27.0-sand_cf/27.0
            if bf>0: add(rows,'BF-COMP',bf)
            add(rows,'GND-DB',L,'GND-4/0'); add(rows,'TAPE',L,'TAPE-DET')
            gwt=boring_gw_ft(b)
            if dep_ft>gwt and gwt<15: add(rows,'DEWATER',L)
        elif m=='HDD':
            ncond=cols*s['rows']; per={2:64.0,4:92.0,6:128.0}.get(ncond,128.0)
            ft=per*L; sub=ft+5400.0
            if s['cover']>96: sub+=0.15*ft
            sub=max(sub,14000.0)
            rows.append(['SUB-HDD',1,'EA',0,0,0,0,sub])
        elif m=='JB':
            ncond=cols*s['rows']; sub=295.0*L+(ncond-1)*88.0*L+6800.0
            rows.append(['SUB-JB',1,'EA',0,0,0,0,sub])
            rows.append(['RGS-5',ncond*L,'LF',0,0,0,mat_unit('RGS-5')*ncond*L,0])
        elif m=='JS':
            ncond=cols*s['rows']; sub=540.0*L+ncond*36.0*L+9800.0
            rows.append(['SUB-JS',1,'EA',0,0,0,0,sub])
            rows.append(['RGS-5',ncond*L,'LF',0,0,0,mat_unit('RGS-5')*ncond*L,0])
    # manholes
    if n_mh is None: n_mh=len(place_manholes(item_id,segs))
    for _ in range(n_mh):
        bw=7.33+4; bl=9.33+4; exc_cy=bw*bl*8/27.0
        add(rows,'EX-MACH',exc_cy)
        rock=bw*bl*0.5/27.0; add(rows,'MH-BASE',rock,'ROCK-BASE')
        bf=exc_cy-(7.33*9.33*7)/27.0-rock
        if bf>0: add(rows,'BF-COMP',bf)
        add(rows,'MH-SET',1,'MH-PRECAST'); add(rows,'TBOX',20)
    # cable
    ckt=sets*(ug_len+6*n_mh+18*n_equip)
    pullcode='PULL-MV-L' if kcmil(size)>=250 else 'PULL-MV'
    if ctype=='DBC':
        dbl=sum(plen(s['pts']) for s in segs if s['method']=='DB'); rest=ug_len-dbl
        add(rows,'DBC-LAY',sets*(dbl+6*n_mh+18*n_equip))
        if rest>0: add(rows,pullcode,sets*rest)
    else:
        add(rows,pullcode,ckt)
    add(rows,'CBL-'+size,3*ckt,'CBL-'+size)
    add(rows,'TERM-MV',3*sets*n_equip,'TERM-KIT')
    if n_mh>0: add(rows,'FIREPROOF',12*3*sets*n_mh,'FIRETAPE')
    # overhead
    if oh:
        Loh=plen(oh['oh_pts']); np=len(oh['poles']); nr=len(oh['riser'])
        add(rows,'POLE-SET',np,'POLE-50' if oh['pole_50'] else 'POLE-45')
        add(rows,'POLE-HOLE',np)
        add(rows,'XARM',np+nr,'XARM-ASSY')
        add(rows,'GUY',nr,'GUY-ASSY')   # riser poles 1 guy each (dead-end 1)
        add(rows,'RISER',nr,'RISER-ASSY')
        add(rows,'STRING',3*Loh*1.015, oh['conductor'])
    return rows, n_mh

# ============================================================ takeoff C05 (building)
def takeoff_c05(ctype, size, sets):
    info=ITEMS['C05']; rows=[]
    # plan route length along corridor (1132->1442 = 310 ft horizontal), plus 2 rises 7ft each
    L=dist((1132,705),(1442,705))  # 310 ft
    rises=2; rise_h=7
    n_equip=2  # MSG-A and USS-A1 (both gear)
    if ctype=='RMC' or ctype=='EMT':
        cond_code='RMC-5' if ctype=='RMC' else 'EMT-4'
        mat_code='RGS-5' if ctype=='RMC' else 'EMT-4IN'
        cond_LF=sets*(L+2*rises)
        add(rows,cond_code,cond_LF,mat_code)
        # elbows: sets x (bends + 2); bends=2 (the 2 corner bends of the route)
        bends=2
        add(rows,'ELBOW-5',sets*(bends+2),'ELBOW-RGS5')
        # firestop per set per rated wall (2 rated walls: ER-A 2hr, MR-1 2hr; plus 1-hr corridor walls)
        n_rated_walls=4  # ER-A entry(2hr), MR-1 entry(2hr), 2 corridor 1-hr walls
        for _ in range(n_rated_walls):
            add(rows,'FIRE-RMC',sets,'FIRESTOP-RMC5')
        # cable circuit-ft = sets x (route + 2 rises + 2x10)
        ckt=sets*(L+2*rises+2*10)
        add(rows,'PULL-IN',ckt)
        add(rows,'CBL-'+size,3*ckt,'CBL-'+size)
        add(rows,'TERM-IN',6*sets,'TERM-KIT')   # 6 per set
        # seismic braces ceil(L/40)+ceil(L/80)
        add(rows,'SEISMIC',math.ceil(L/40)+math.ceil(L/80),'SEISMIC-BR')
    else:  # TRAY-EN or TRAY-LD
        tray_code='TRAY-24'; tray_mat='TRAY-24-SB' if ctype=='TRAY-EN' else 'TRAY-24-LD'
        add(rows,tray_code,L,tray_mat)
        if ctype=='TRAY-EN':
            add(rows,'TRAY-COV',L,'TRAY-COV-24')  # enclosed cover
        add(rows,'TRAY-BOND',L,'BOND-2')
        # RMC drops sets x 2 rises with 2 elbows per set
        add(rows,'RMC-5',sets*2*rises,'RGS-5')
        add(rows,'ELBOW-5',sets*2*2,'ELBOW-RGS5')
        # sleeves per 2-hour wall (2), firestop per set per 1-hour wall (2)
        add(rows,'FIRE-SLV',2,'FIRE-SLV-4')  # 2 two-hour walls
        for _ in range(2): add(rows,'FIRE-RMC',sets,'FIRESTOP-RMC5')
        add(rows,'SEISMIC',math.ceil(L/40)+math.ceil(L/80),'SEISMIC-BR')
        ckt=sets*(L+2*rises+2*10)
        add(rows,'PULL-IN',ckt)
        add(rows,'CBL-'+size,3*ckt,'CBL-'+size)
        add(rows,'TERM-IN',6*sets,'TERM-KIT')
    return rows

# ============================================================ cost roll-up (per-alternative direct cost)
def direct_cost(rows):
    lab=sum(r[4] for r in rows); eq=sum(r[5] for r in rows); mat=sum(r[6] for r in rows); sub=sum(r[7] for r in rows)
    mh=sum(r[3] for r in rows)
    return mh,lab,eq,mat,sub

# bond effective rate from sum of recommended (direct+JOOH+HOOH+profit)
BOND_EFF={'rate':0.0}
def bond_premium(S):
    p=0.0
    for lo,hi,rate in [(0,100000,0.025),(100000,400000,0.015),(400000,2000000,0.010),(2000000,2500000,0.0075),(2500000,1e18,0.0065)]:
        if S>lo:
            p+=rate*(min(S,hi)-lo)
    return p*(1+BOND_SURCHARGE)
def compute_bond_eff(recos):
    S=sum(r['direct']*ACF*(1+JOOH_PCT)*(1+HOOH_PCT)*(1+PROFIT_PCT) for r in recos)
    prem=bond_premium(S)
    BOND_EFF['rate']=prem/S if S>0 else 0.0

# ============================================================ admissibility
# site items: CEDB Y; UEDB N (IEDS 4.2); DBC N (IEDS 4.2); HDD N (entire run - IEDS 4.3 bores only crossings); OH depends
SITE_ADM={

def dist(p,q): return math.hypot(p[0]-q[0],p[1]-q[1])

# ============================================================ ampacity helpers
def amp_ductbank(size,circ,rho,lf,depth_in,amb=25):
    rho=next_rho(rho)
    base=DB_AMP.get((size,circ,rho,lf))
    if base is None: return None
    d=next_depth_tab(depth_in)
    dc=DEPTH_CORR[size].get(str(d),1.0)
    ac=AMB_CORR[size].get(str(amb),1.0)
    return base*dc*ac
def amp_single(size,rho,depth_in,lf,amb=25):
    rho=next_rho(rho); d=next_depth_tab(depth_in)
    base=SC_AMP.get((size,rho,d,lf))
    if base is None: return None
    return base*AMB_CORR[size].get(str(amb),1.0)
def amp_dburial(size,rho,lf,amb=25):
    rho=next_rho(rho); base=DBR_AMP.get((size,rho,lf))

        for si in range(ORDER.index(scsize),len(ORDER)):
            s=ORDER[si]; amp=ampfn(s,sets)
            if amp is None: continue

    info=ITEMS[iid]; legs=LEGS[iid]

def place_manholes(item_id, segs):
    """Place manholes so first<=180ft from source, last<=180ft from dest, spacing<=380ft on straight runs;
    returns list of (x,y) positions along route."""
    info=ITEMS[item_id]; src=info['src']; dst=info['dst']
    # build cumulative polyline of underground methods only (CE/UE/DB); HDD/JB connect via manholes too
    pts=[]; cuts=[]  # cuts = (method, length)
    for s in segs:
        if s['method'] in ('CE','UE','DB','HDD','JB','JS'):
            for i,p in enumerate(s['pts']):
                if not pts or p!=pts[-1]:
                    pts.append(p)
    if not pts: return []
    # total length and parametrize
    L=plen(pts)
    # positions from source along pts
    def pos_at(d):
        acc=0
        for i in range(len(pts)-1):
            segL=dist(pts[i],pts[i+1])
            if acc+segL>=d:
                t=(d-acc)/segL
                return (pts[i][0]+t*(pts[i+1][0]-pts[i][0]), pts[i][1]+t*(pts[i+1][1]-pts[i][1]))
            acc+=segL
        return pts[-1]

def place_manholes(item_id, segs):
    """Place manholes so first<=180ft from source, last<=180ft from dest, spacing<=380ft on straight runs;
    returns list of (x,y) positions along route."""
    info=ITEMS[item_id]; src=info['src']; dst=info['dst']
    # build cumulative polyline of underground methods only (CE/UE/DB); HDD/JB connect via manholes too
    pts=[]; cuts=[]  # cuts = (method, length)
    for s in segs:
        if s['method'] in ('CE','UE','DB','HDD','JB','JS'):
            for i,p in enumerate(s['pts']):
                if not pts or p!=pts[-1]:
                    pts.append(p)
    if not pts: return []
    # total length and parametrize
    L=plen(pts)
    # positions from source along pts
    def pos_at(d):
        acc=0
        for i in range(len(pts)-1):
            segL=dist(pts[i],pts[i+1])
            if acc+segL>=d:
                t=(d-acc)/segL
                return (pts[i][0]+t*(pts[i+1][0]-pts[i][0]), pts[i][1]+t*(pts[i+1][1]-pts[i][1]))
            acc+=segL
        return pts[-1]
    positions=[]
    first=150; last=180; spacing=380
    d=first
    while d<L-last:
        positions.append(pos_at(d)); d+=spacing
    return positions

# ============================================================ manhole placement (auto)
def place_manholes(item_id, segs):
    """Place manholes so first<=180ft from source, last<=180ft from dest, spacing<=380ft on straight runs;
    returns list of (x,y) positions along route."""
    info=ITEMS[item_id]; src=info['src']; dst=info['dst']
    # build cumulative polyline of underground methods only (CE/UE/DB); HDD/JB connect via manholes too
    pts=[]; cuts=[]  # cuts = (method, length)
    for s in segs:
        if s['method'] in ('CE','UE','DB','HDD','JB','JS'):
            for i,p in enumerate(s['pts']):
                if not pts or p!=pts[-1]:
                    pts.append(p)
    if not pts: return []
    # total length and parametrize
    L=plen(pts)
    # positions from source along pts
    def pos_at(d):
        acc=0
        for i in range(len(pts)-1):
            segL=dist(pts[i],pts[i+1])
            if acc+segL>=d:
                t=(d-acc)/segL
                return (pts[i][0]+t*(pts[i+1][0]-pts[i][0]), pts[i][1]+t*(pts[i+1][1]-pts[i][1]))
            acc+=segL
        return pts[-1]
    positions=[]
    first=150; last=180; spacing=380
    d=first
    while d<L-last:
        positions.append(pos_at(d)); d+=spacing
    return positions

    L=plen(pts)

                return (pts[i][0]+t*(pts[i+1][0]-pts[i][0]), pts[i][1]+t*(pts[i+1][1]-pts[i][1]))

        # avoid duplicates/too-close
        if positions and dist(positions[-1],p)<60:

def mh_ok(x,y):
    for (x0,y0,x1,y1) in PAVE_RECTS+BLDG_RECTS:
        if x0<=x<=x1 and y0<=y<=y1: return False
    if CHAN[0]<=x<=CHAN[2] and CHAN[1]<=y<=CHAN[3]: return False
    if RAILBAND[0]<=x<=RAILBAND[2] and RAILBAND[1]<=y<=RAILBAND[3]: return False
    for (tx,ty,r) in TREES_RET:
        if (tx-x)**2+(ty-y)**2 < (r+4)**2: return False   # 4ft working room beyond TPZ
    return True
def place_manholes(item_id, segs):
    """Place manholes: first<=180ft from source, last<=180ft from dest, spacing<=380ft,
    avoiding pavement, buildings, channel buffer, rail band and tree protection zones."""
    pts=[]
    for s in segs:
        if s['method'] in ('CE','UE','DB','HDD','JB','JS'):
            for p in s['pts']:
                if not pts or p!=pts[-1]: pts.append(p)
    if not pts: return []
    L=plen(pts)
    def pos_at(d):
        acc=0
        for i in range(len(pts)-1):
            segL=dist(pts[i],pts[i+1])
            if acc+segL>=d:
                t=(d-acc)/segL
                return (pts[i][0]+t*(pts[i+1][0]-pts[i][0]), pts[i][1]+t*(pts[i+1][1]-pts[i][1]))
            acc+=segL
        return pts[-1]
    positions=[]
    first=150; last=180; spacing=380
    d=first
    while d<L-last:
        p=pos_at(d)
        if not mh_ok(*p):
            # walk back to a valid position
            dd=d; ok=False
            while dd>1:
                dd-=5; q=pos_at(dd)
                if mh_ok(*q): p=q; ok=True; break
            if not ok:
                dd=d
                while dd<L-1:
                    dd+=5; q=pos_at(dd)
                    if mh_ok(*q): p=q; ok=True; break
            if not ok:
                d+=spacing; continue
        # avoid duplicates/too-close
        if positions and dist(positions[-1],p)<60:
            d+=spacing; continue
        positions.append(p)
        d+=spacing
    return positions

def mh_ok(x,y):
    for (x0,y0,x1,y1) in PAVE_RECTS+BLDG_RECTS:
        if x0<=x<=x1 and y0<=y<=y1: return False
    if CHAN[0]<=x<=CHAN[2] and CHAN[1]<=y<=CHAN[3]: return False
    if RAILBAND[0]<=x<=RAILBAND[2] and RAILBAND[1]<=y<=RAILBAND[3]: return False
    for (tx,ty,r) in TREES_RET:
        if (tx-x)**2+(ty-y)**2 < (r+4)**2: return False   # 4ft working room beyond TPZ
    return True
def place_manholes(item_id, segs):
    """Place manholes: first<=180ft from source, last<=180ft from dest, spacing<=380ft,
    avoiding pavement, buildings, channel buffer, rail band and tree protection zones."""
    pts=[]
    for s in segs:
        if s['method'] in ('CE','UE','DB','HDD','JB','JS'):
            for p in s['pts']:
                if not pts or p!=pts[-1]: pts.append(p)
    if not pts: return []
    L=plen(pts)
    def pos_at(d):
        acc=0
        for i in range(len(pts)-1):
            segL=dist(pts[i],pts[i+1])
            if acc+segL>=d:
                t=(d-acc)/segL
                return (pts[i][0]+t*(pts[i+1][0]-pts[i][0]), pts[i][1]+t*(pts[i+1][1]-pts[i][1]))
            acc+=segL
        return pts[-1]
    positions=[]
    first=150; last=180; spacing=380
    d=first
    while d<L-last:
        p=pos_at(d)
        if not mh_ok(*p):
            # walk back to a valid position
            dd=d; ok=False
            while dd>1:
                dd-=5; q=pos_at(dd)
                if mh_ok(*q): p=q; ok=True; break
            if not ok:
                dd=d
                while dd<L-1:
                    dd+=5; q=pos_at(dd)
                    if mh_ok(*q): p=q; ok=True; break
            if not ok:
                d+=spacing; continue
        # avoid duplicates/too-close
        if positions and dist(positions[-1],p)<60:
            d+=spacing; continue
        positions.append(p)
        d+=spacing
    return positions

def mh_ok(x,y):
    for (x0,y0,x1,y1) in PAVE_RECTS+BLDG_RECTS:
        if x0<=x<=x1 and y0<=y<=y1: return False
    if CHAN[0]<=x<=CHAN[2] and CHAN[1]<=y<=CHAN[3]: return False
    if RAILBAND[0]<=x<=RAILBAND[2] and RAILBAND[1]<=y<=RAILBAND[3]: return False
    for (tx,ty,r) in TREES_RET:
        if (tx-x)**2+(ty-y)**2 < (r+4)**2: return False   # 4ft working room beyond TPZ
    return True
def place_manholes(item_id, segs):
    """Place manholes: first<=180ft from source, last<=180ft from dest, spacing<=380ft,
    avoiding pavement, buildings, channel buffer, rail band and tree protection zones."""
    pts=[]
    for s in segs:
        if s['method'] in ('CE','UE','DB','HDD','JB','JS'):
            for p in s['pts']:
                if not pts or p!=pts[-1]: pts.append(p)
    if not pts: return []
    L=plen(pts)
    def pos_at(d):
        acc=0
        for i in range(len(pts)-1):
            segL=dist(pts[i],pts[i+1])
            if acc+segL>=d:
                t=(d-acc)/segL
                return (pts[i][0]+t*(pts[i+1][0]-pts[i][0]), pts[i][1]+t*(pts[i+1][1]-pts[i][1]))
            acc+=segL
        return pts[-1]
    positions=[]
    first=150; last=180; spacing=380
    d=first
    while d<L-last:
        p=pos_at(d)
        if not mh_ok(*p):
            # walk back to a valid position
            dd=d; ok=False
            while dd>1:
                dd-=5; q=pos_at(dd)
                if mh_ok(*q): p=q; ok=True; break
            if not ok:
                dd=d
                while dd<L-1:
                    dd+=5; q=pos_at(dd)
                    if mh_ok(*q): p=q; ok=True; break
            if not ok:
                d+=spacing; continue
        # avoid duplicates/too-close
        if positions and dist(positions[-1],p)<60:
            d+=spacing; continue
        positions.append(p)
        d+=spacing
    return positions

CHAN=(1575,275,1665,1300)
RAILBAND=(0,1085.6,1000,1114.4)
TREES_RET=[(520,655,20),(245,820,16),(900,1030,18),(650,1118,12),(600,520,16),(1070,700,12),(1300,900,22)]
def mh_ok(x,y):
    for (x0,y0,x1,y1) in PAVE_RECTS+BLDG_RECTS:
        if x0<=x<=x1 and y0<=y<=y1: return False
    if CHAN[0]<=x<=CHAN[2] and CHAN[1]<=y<=CHAN[3]: return False
    if RAILBAND[0]<=x<=RAILBAND[2] and RAILBAND[1]<=y<=RAILBAND[3]: return False
    for (tx,ty,r) in TREES_RET:
        if (tx-x)**2+(ty-y)**2 < (r+4)**2: return False   # 4ft working room beyond TPZ
    return True
def place_manholes(item_id, segs):
    """Place manholes: first<=180ft from source, last<=180ft from dest, spacing<=380ft,
    avoiding pavement, buildings, channel buffer, rail band and tree protection zones."""
    pts=[]
    for s in segs:
        if s['method'] in ('CE','UE','DB','HDD','JB','JS'):
            for p in s['pts']:
                if not pts or p!=pts[-1]: pts.append(p)
    if not pts: return []
    L=plen(pts)
    def pos_at(d):
        acc=0
        for i in range(len(pts)-1):
            segL=dist(pts[i],pts[i+1])
            if acc+segL>=d:
                t=(d-acc)/segL
                return (pts[i][0]+t*(pts[i+1][0]-pts[i][0]), pts[i][1]+t*(pts[i+1][1]-pts[i][1]))
            acc+=segL
        return pts[-1]
    positions=[]
    first=150; last=180; spacing=380
    d=first
    while d<L-last:
        p=pos_at(d)
        if not mh_ok(*p):
            # walk back to a valid position
            dd=d; ok=False
            while dd>1:
                dd-=5; q=pos_at(dd)
                if mh_ok(*q): p=q; ok=True; break
            if not ok:
                dd=d
                while dd<L-1:
                    dd+=5; q=pos_at(dd)
                    if mh_ok(*q): p=q; ok=True; break
            if not ok:
                d+=spacing; continue
        # avoid duplicates/too-close
        if positions and dist(positions[-1],p)<60:
            d+=spacing; continue
        positions.append(p)
        d+=spacing
    return positions

def add(rows, code, qty, matcode=None, sub=0):
    if code in LU:
        mh,crew=lu_mh(code, large_string=(code=='STRING'))

        mh,crew=0.0,None
    mhr=mh*qty
    if crew:
        crate=crew_avg_rate(crew); cer=crew_eq_rate(crew); csize=CREWS[crew][0]
        lab=mhr*crate; eq=(mhr/csize)*cer if csize else 0
        unit=LU[code][1]
    else:
        lab=0; eq=0; unit=MAT[code][1] if code in MAT else 'EA'
    mat=mat_unit(matcode)*qty if (matcode and qty and qty>0) else 0
    rows.append([code,qty,unit,mhr,lab,eq,mat,sub])

    n_equip=2
    for s in segs:
        L=plen(s['pts']); m=s['method']; cols=s['cols']; rows_n=s['rows']; ducts=cols*rows_n
        od=COND[s['ductsize']][0]
        if m in ('CE','UE'):
            ew=cols*od+(cols-1)*3+(6 if m=='CE' else 0)
            eh=rows_n*od+(rows_n-1)*3+(6 if m=='CE' else 0)
            botw=ew+12; dep_in=s['cover']+eh+3; dep_ft=dep_in/12.0
            b=nearest_boring(*midpt(s)); st=soil_type(b,dep_ft); sl=SLOPE[st]
            # protective system: trench shield (box) for >=5ft (narrower than sloping); TBOX applies
            if dep_ft>=5:
                exc_cf=(botw/12.0)*dep_ft*L; prot='box'; boxlen=L
            else:
                exc_cf=(botw/12.0)*dep_ft*L; prot='none'; boxlen=0
            add(rows,'EX-MACH',exc_cf/27.0)
            duct_area=ducts*(math.pi/4.0)*(od/12.0)**2*L
            env_cf=(ew/12.0)*(eh/12.0)*L
            if m=='CE':
                conc_cy=(env_cf-duct_area)/27.0

                bf=exc_cf/27.0-env_cf/27.0
            else:
                # UE: sand = trench bottom width x (envelope height + 6 + 3) - envelope(bounding box); backfill = exc - envelope - sand
                sand_cf=(botw/12.0)*((eh+9)/12.0)*L - env_cf
                add(rows,'SAND-BED',sand_cf/27.0,'SAND')
                bf=exc_cf/27.0-env_cf/27.0-sand_cf/27.0
            if bf>0: add(rows,'BF-COMP',bf)
            matcode='EB20-5' if s['ductsize']=='HDPE-5' else s['ductsize']
            add(rows,'DUCT-CE' if m=='CE' else 'DUCT-UE', ducts*L, matcode)
            add(rows,'SPACER', ducts*(int(L//5)+1),'SPACER')
            if boxlen>0: add(rows,'TBOX',boxlen)
            if m=='CE' and s['reinforced']:
                nb=6 if ew>30 else 4
                rebar=nb*0.668*L+(int(L//3)+1)*((2*(ew-3)+2*(eh-3))/12.0)*0.376
                add(rows,'REBAR',rebar,'REBAR-4')
            add(rows,'GND-DB',L,'GND-4/0'); add(rows,'TAPE',L,'TAPE-DET')
            if s['paved']:
                topw=botw+(2*sl*dep_in if prot=='slope' else 0)
                add(rows,'PAVE-CUT',L*(topw/12.0+2)/9.0,'ASPHALT')
            gwt=boring_gw_ft(b)
            if dep_ft>gwt and gwt<15: add(rows,'DEWATER',L)
        elif m=='DB':
            ch=2.155*CABLE[size][0]; botw=8; dep_in=s['cover']+ch+3; dep_ft=dep_in/12.0
            b=nearest_boring(*midpt(s)); st=soil_type(b,dep_ft); sl=SLOPE[st]
            add(rows,'EX-TRCH',L)
            sand_cf=(botw/12.0)*((ch+6)/12.0)*L
            add(rows,'SAND-BED',sand_cf/27.0,'SAND')
            exc_cf=(botw/12.0)*dep_ft*L   # trench box keeps narrow width
            bf=exc_cf/27.0-sand_cf/27.0
            if bf>0: add(rows,'BF-COMP',bf)
            if dep_ft>=5: add(rows,'TBOX',L)
            add(rows,'GND-DB',L,'GND-4/0'); add(rows,'TAPE',L,'TAPE-DET')
            gwt=boring_gw_ft(b)
            if dep_ft>gwt and gwt<15: add(rows,'DEWATER',L)
        elif m=='HDD':
            ncond=cols*s['rows']; per={2:64.0,4:92.0,6:128.0}.get(ncond,128.0)
            ft=per*L; sub=ft+5400.0
            if s['cover']>96: sub+=0.15*ft

        elif m=='JB':

            rows.append(['RGS-5',ncond*L,'LF',0,0,0,mat_unit('RGS-5')*ncond*L,0])

            rows.append(['RGS-5',ncond*L,'LF',0,0,0,mat_unit('RGS-5')*ncond*L,0])
    # manholes
    if n_mh is None: n_mh=len(place_manholes(item_id,segs))

def direct_cost(rows):
    lab=sum(r[4] for r in rows); eq=sum(r[5] for r in rows); mat=sum(r[6] for r in rows); sub=sum(r[7] for r in rows)
    mh=sum(r[3] for r in rows)
    return mh,lab,eq,mat,sub

# bond effective rate from sum of recommended (direct+JOOH+HOOH+profit)
BOND_EFF={'rate':0.0}
def bond_premium(S):
    p=0.0
    for lo,hi,rate in [(0,100000,0.025),(100000,400000,0.015),(400000,2000000,0.010),(2000000,2500000,0.0075),(2500000,1e18,0.0065)]:
        if S>lo:
            p+=rate*(min(S,hi)-lo)
    return p*(1+BOND_SURCHARGE)
def compute_bond_eff(recos):
    S=sum(r['direct']*ACF*(1+JOOH_PCT)*(1+HOOH_PCT)*(1+PROFIT_PCT) for r in recos)
    prem=bond_premium(S)
    BOND_EFF['rate']=prem/S if S>0 else 0.0

def place_manholes(item_id, segs):
    """Place manholes: first<=180ft from source, last<=180ft from dest, spacing<=380ft,
    avoiding pavement, buildings, channel buffer, rail band and tree protection zones."""
    pts=[]
    for s in segs:
        if s['method'] in ('CE','UE','DB','HDD','JB','JS'):
            for p in s['pts']:
                if not pts or p!=pts[-1]: pts.append(p)
    if not pts: return []
    L=plen(pts)
    def pos_at(d):
        acc=0
        for i in range(len(pts)-1):
            segL=dist(pts[i],pts[i+1])
            if acc+segL>=d:
                t=(d-acc)/segL
                return (pts[i][0]+t*(pts[i+1][0]-pts[i][0]), pts[i][1]+t*(pts[i+1][1]-pts[i][1]))
            acc+=segL
        return pts[-1]
    positions=[]
    first=150; last=180; spacing=380
    d=first
    while d<L-last:
        p=pos_at(d)
        if not mh_ok(*p):
            # walk back to a valid position
            dd=d; ok=False
            while dd>1:
                dd-=5; q=pos_at(dd)
                if mh_ok(*q): p=q; ok=True; break
            if not ok:
                dd=d
                while dd<L-1:
                    dd+=5; q=pos_at(dd)
                    if mh_ok(*q): p=q; ok=True; break
            if not ok:
                d+=spacing; continue
        # avoid duplicates/too-close
        if positions and dist(positions[-1],p)<60:
            d+=spacing; continue
        positions.append(p)
        d+=spacing
    return positions

def size_cable(item_id, ampfn, scsize):
    I=ITEMS[item_id]['I']; best=None
    for sets in range(1,5):
        for si in range(ORDER.index(scsize),len(ORDER)):
            s=ORDER[si]; amp=ampfn(s,sets)
            if amp is None: continue
            if sets*amp>=I:
                key=sets*CABLE[s][2]
                if best is None or key<best[0]: best=(key,(s,sets,amp))
    if best is None:
        s='1000'; return s,3,ampfn(s,3)
    return best[1]

def spares_rule(n_occ):

    s=1

PAVE_RECTS=[(0,60,1900,90),(760,90,790,1300),(790,822,1100,846),(300,760,640,900),(600,930,700,1060)]
BLDG_RECTS=[(80,480,280,700),(1100,420,1500,820),(420,960,600,1060),(700,1150,1000,1260),(1830,100,1870,140),(1790,1170,1830,1210)]
CHAN=(1575,275,1665,1300)
RAILBAND=(0,1085.6,1000,1114.4)
TREES_RET=[(520,655,20),(245,820,16),(900,1030,18),(650,1118,12),(600,520,16),(1070,700,12),(1300,900,22)]
def mh_ok(x,y):
    for (x0,y0,x1,y1) in PAVE_RECTS+BLDG_RECTS:
        if x0<=x<=x1 and y0<=y<=y1: return False
    if CHAN[0]<=x<=CHAN[2] and CHAN[1]<=y<=CHAN[3]: return False
    if RAILBAND[0]<=x<=RAILBAND[2] and RAILBAND[1]<=y<=RAILBAND[3]: return False
    for (tx,ty,r) in TREES_RET:
        if (tx-x)**2+(ty-y)**2 < (r+4)**2: return False   # 4ft working room beyond TPZ
    return True
def place_manholes(item_id, segs):
    """Place manholes: first<=180ft from source, last<=180ft from dest, spacing<=380ft,
    avoiding pavement, buildings, channel buffer, rail band and tree protection zones."""
    pts=[]
    for s in segs:
        if s['method'] in ('CE','UE','DB','HDD','JB','JS'):
            for p in s['pts']:
                if not pts or p!=pts[-1]: pts.append(p)
    if not pts: return []
    L=plen(pts)
    def pos_at(d):
        acc=0
        for i in range(len(pts)-1):
            segL=dist(pts[i],pts[i+1])
            if acc+segL>=d:
                t=(d-acc)/segL
                return (pts[i][0]+t*(pts[i+1][0]-pts[i][0]), pts[i][1]+t*(pts[i+1][1]-pts[i][1]))
            acc+=segL
        return pts[-1]
    positions=[]
    first=150; last=180; spacing=380
    d=first
    while d<L-last:
        p=pos_at(d)
        if not mh_ok(*p):
            # walk back to a valid position
            dd=d; ok=False
            while dd>1:
                dd-=5; q=pos_at(dd)
                if mh_ok(*q): p=q; ok=True; break
            if not ok:
                dd=d
                while dd<L-1:
                    dd+=5; q=pos_at(dd)
                    if mh_ok(*q): p=q; ok=True; break
            if not ok:
                d+=spacing; continue
        # avoid duplicates/too-close
        if positions and dist(positions[-1],p)<60:
            d+=spacing; continue
        positions.append(p)
        d+=spacing
    return positions

def add(rows, code, qty, matcode=None, sub=0):
    if code in LU:
        mh,crew=lu_mh(code, large_string=(code=='STRING'))
    else:
        mh,crew=0.0,None
    mhr=mh*qty
    if crew:
        crate=crew_avg_rate(crew); cer=crew_eq_rate(crew); csize=CREWS[crew][0]
        lab=mhr*crate; eq=(mhr/csize)*cer if csize else 0
        unit=LU[code][1]
    else:
        lab=0; eq=0; unit=MAT[code][1] if code in MAT else 'EA'
    mat=mat_unit(matcode)*qty if (matcode and qty and qty>0) else 0
    rows.append([code,qty,unit,mhr,lab,eq,mat,sub])

def takeoff_site(item_id, ctype, segs, size, sets, oh=None, n_mh=None):
    info=ITEMS[item_id]; rows=[]
    ug_len=sum(plen(s['pts']) for s in segs if s['method'] in ('CE','UE','DB','HDD','JB','JS'))
    n_equip=2
    for s in segs:
        L=plen(s['pts']); m=s['method']; cols=s['cols']; rows_n=s['rows']; ducts=cols*rows_n
        od=COND[s['ductsize']][0]
        if m in ('CE','UE'):
            ew=cols*od+(cols-1)*3+(6 if m=='CE' else 0)
            eh=rows_n*od+(rows_n-1)*3+(6 if m=='CE' else 0)
            botw=ew+12; dep_in=s['cover']+eh+3; dep_ft=dep_in/12.0
            b=nearest_boring(*midpt(s)); st=soil_type(b,dep_ft); sl=SLOPE[st]
            # protective system: trench shield (box) for >=5ft (narrower than sloping); TBOX applies
            if dep_ft>=5:
                exc_cf=(botw/12.0)*dep_ft*L; prot='box'; boxlen=L
            else:
                exc_cf=(botw/12.0)*dep_ft*L; prot='none'; boxlen=0
            add(rows,'EX-MACH',exc_cf/27.0)
            duct_area=ducts*(math.pi/4.0)*(od/12.0)**2*L
            env_cf=(ew/12.0)*(eh/12.0)*L
            if m=='CE':
                conc_cy=(env_cf-duct_area)/27.0
                add(rows,'CONC-PL',conc_cy,'CONC-3000')
                bf=exc_cf/27.0-env_cf/27.0
            else:
                # UE: sand = trench bottom width x (envelope height + 6 + 3) - envelope(bounding box); backfill = exc - envelope - sand
                sand_cf=(botw/12.0)*((eh+9)/12.0)*L - env_cf
                add(rows,'SAND-BED',sand_cf/27.0,'SAND')
                bf=exc_cf/27.0-env_cf/27.0-sand_cf/27.0
            if bf>0: add(rows,'BF-COMP',bf)
            matcode='EB20-5' if s['ductsize']=='HDPE-5' else s['ductsize']
            add(rows,'DUCT-CE' if m=='CE' else 'DUCT-UE', ducts*L, matcode)
            add(rows,'SPACER', ducts*(int(L//5)+1),'SPACER')
            if boxlen>0: add(rows,'TBOX',boxlen)
            if m=='CE' and s['reinforced']:
                nb=6 if ew>30 else 4
                rebar=nb*0.668*L+(int(L//3)+1)*((2*(ew-3)+2*(eh-3))/12.0)*0.376
                add(rows,'REBAR',rebar,'REBAR-4')
            add(rows,'GND-DB',L,'GND-4/0'); add(rows,'TAPE',L,'TAPE-DET')
            if s['paved']:
                topw=botw+(2*sl*dep_in if prot=='slope' else 0)
                add(rows,'PAVE-CUT',L*(topw/12.0+2)/9.0,'ASPHALT')
            gwt=boring_gw_ft(b)
            if dep_ft>gwt and gwt<15: add(rows,'DEWATER',L)
        elif m=='DB':
            ch=2.155*CABLE[size][0]; botw=8; dep_in=s['cover']+ch+3; dep_ft=dep_in/12.0
            b=nearest_boring(*midpt(s)); st=soil_type(b,dep_ft); sl=SLOPE[st]
            add(rows,'EX-TRCH',L)
            sand_cf=(botw/12.0)*((ch+6)/12.0)*L
            add(rows,'SAND-BED',sand_cf/27.0,'SAND')
            exc_cf=(botw/12.0)*dep_ft*L   # trench box keeps narrow width
            bf=exc_cf/27.0-sand_cf/27.0
            if bf>0: add(rows,'BF-COMP',bf)
            if dep_ft>=5: add(rows,'TBOX',L)
            add(rows,'GND-DB',L,'GND-4/0'); add(rows,'TAPE',L,'TAPE-DET')
            gwt=boring_gw_ft(b)
            if dep_ft>gwt and gwt<15: add(rows,'DEWATER',L)
        elif m=='HDD':
            ncond=cols*s['rows']; per={2:64.0,4:92.0,6:128.0}.get(ncond,128.0)
            ft=per*L; sub=ft+5400.0
            if s['cover']>96: sub+=0.15*ft
            sub=max(sub,14000.0)
            rows.append(['SUB-HDD',1,'EA',0,0,0,0,sub])
        elif m=='JB':
            ncond=cols*s['rows']; sub=295.0*L+(ncond-1)*88.0*L+6800.0
            rows.append(['SUB-JB',1,'EA',0,0,0,0,sub])
            rows.append(['RGS-5',ncond*L,'LF',0,0,0,mat_unit('RGS-5')*ncond*L,0])
        elif m=='JS':
            ncond=cols*s['rows']; sub=540.0*L+ncond*36.0*L+9800.0
            rows.append(['SUB-JS',1,'EA',0,0,0,0,sub])
            rows.append(['RGS-5',ncond*L,'LF',0,0,0,mat_unit('RGS-5')*ncond*L,0])
    # manholes
    if n_mh is None: n_mh=len(place_manholes(item_id,segs))
    for _ in range(n_mh):
        bw=7.33+4; bl=9.33+4; exc_cy=bw*bl*8/27.0
        add(rows,'EX-MACH',exc_cy)
        rock=bw*bl*0.5/27.0; add(rows,'MH-BASE',rock,'ROCK-BASE')
        bf=exc_cy-(7.33*9.33*7)/27.0-rock
        if bf>0: add(rows,'BF-COMP',bf)
        add(rows,'MH-SET',1,'MH-PRECAST'); add(rows,'TBOX',20)
    # cable: circuit-ft = sets x (UG route + 6/mh + 18/equip terminal + 40/riser pole)
    n_riser=len(oh['riser']) if oh else 0
    ckt=sets*(ug_len+6*n_mh+18*n_equip+40*n_riser)
    pullcode='PULL-MV-L' if kcmil(size)>=250 else 'PULL-MV'
    if ctype=='DBC':
        dbl=sum(plen(s['pts']) for s in segs if s['method']=='DB'); rest=ug_len-dbl
        add(rows,'DBC-LAY',sets*(dbl+6*n_mh+18*n_equip+40*n_riser))

    add(rows,'CBL-'+size,3*ckt,'CBL-'+size)
    add(rows,'TERM-MV',3*sets*n_equip,'TERM-KIT')
    if n_mh>0: add(rows,'FIREPROOF',12*3*sets*n_mh,'FIRETAPE')
    # overhead
    if oh:

        add(rows,'XARM',oh.get('xarms',np+nr),'XARM-ASSY')
        add(rows,'GUY',oh.get('guys',nr),'GUY-ASSY')
        add(rows,'RISER',nr,'RISER-ASSY')
        add(rows,'STRING',3*Loh*1.015, oh['conductor'])

def takeoff_c05(ctype, size, sets):

    L=dist((1132,705),(1442,705))  # 310 ft

        bends=2

        for _ in range(n_rated_walls):

        ckt=sets*(L+2*rise_h+2*10)

# ============================================================ cost roll-up (per-alternative direct cost)
def direct_cost(rows):
    lab=sum(r[4] for r in rows); eq=sum(r[5] for r in rows); mat=sum(r[6] for r in rows); sub=sum(r[7] for r in rows)
    mh=sum(r[3] for r in rows)
    return mh,lab,eq,mat,sub

# bond effective rate from sum of recommended (direct+JOOH+HOOH+profit)
BOND_EFF={'rate':0.0}
def bond_premium(S):
    p=0.0
    for lo,hi,rate in [(0,100000,0.025),(100000,400000,0.015),(400000,2000000,0.010),(2000000,2500000,0.0075),(2500000,1e18,0.0065)]:
        if S>lo:
            p+=rate*(min(S,hi)-lo)
    return p*(1+BOND_SURCHARGE)
def compute_bond_eff(recos):
    S=sum(r['direct']*ACF*(1+JOOH_PCT)*(1+HOOH_PCT)*(1+PROFIT_PCT) for r in recos)
    prem=bond_premium(S)
    BOND_EFF['rate']=prem/S if S>0 else 0.0

    L=plen(pts)
    def pos_at(d):
        acc=0

            if acc+segL>=d:

                return (pts[i][0]+t*(pts[i+1][0]-pts[i][0]), pts[i][1]+t*(pts[i+1][1]-pts[i][1]))
            acc+=segL

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Build conveyance_study.xlsx + report for PCSFA 13.8 kV conveyance study.
Produces output/submission.zip with conveyance_study.xlsx and conveyance_study_report.md.
"""
import os, math, zipfile, datetime
from build_data import *

HERE=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
OUT=os.path.join(HERE,"output"); os.makedirs(OUT,exist_ok=True)

# ============================================================ geometry
def dist(p,q): return math.hypot(p[0]-q[0],p[1]-q[1])
def plen(pts): return sum(dist(pts[i],pts[i+1]) for i in range(len(pts)-1))
def midpt(s): return ((s['pts'][0][0]+s['pts'][-1][0])/2,(s['pts'][0][1]+s['pts'][-1][1])/2)

# ============================================================ items
# item: src,dst (site ft), I (design current A), lf(%), fk (fault kA @0.5s), terminals(type)
ITEMS={
 'C01':dict(src=(280,640),dst=(1100,730),I=640,lf=100,fk=16.5),
 'C02':dict(src=(280,520),dst=(1330,420),I=560,lf=100,fk=16.5),
 'C03':dict(src=(240,700),dst=(470,960), I=400,lf=75, fk=16.5),
 'C04':dict(src=(600,1020),dst=(1760,1152),I=60,lf=75,fk=14.2),
 'C05':dict(src=(1132,732),dst=(1442,642),I=200,lf=75,fk=15.8),
 'C06':dict(src=(180,480),dst=(1800,122),I=40,lf=75,fk=16.5),
 'C07':dict(src=(470,1060),dst=(1030,1172),I=120,lf=75,fk=14.2),
}
ORDER=['1/0','2/0','4/0','250','350','500','750','1000']
def sc_min(fk):
    for s in ORDER:
        if SC_05[s]>=fk: return s
    return '1000'
def kcmil(s): return {'1/0':105.6,'2/0':133.1,'4/0':211.6,'250':250,'350':350,'500':500,'750':750,'1000':1000}[s]

# ============================================================ ampacity helpers
def amp_ductbank(size,circ,rho,lf,depth_in,amb=25):
    rho=next_rho(rho)
    base=DB_AMP.get((size,circ,rho,lf))
    if base is None: return None
    d=next_depth_tab(depth_in)
    dc=DEPTH_CORR[size].get(str(d),1.0)
    ac=AMB_CORR[size].get(str(amb),1.0)
    return base*dc*ac
def amp_single(size,rho,depth_in,lf,amb=25):
    rho=next_rho(rho); d=next_depth_tab(depth_in)
    base=SC_AMP.get((size,rho,d,lf))
    if base is None: return None
    return base*AMB_CORR[size].get(str(amb),1.0)
def amp_dburial(size,rho,lf,amb=25):
    rho=next_rho(rho); base=DBR_AMP.get((size,rho,lf))
    if base is None: return None
    return base*AMB_CORR[size].get(str(amb),1.0)
def amp_air(size,install,amb=40): return AIR_AMP.get((size,install,amb))
def amp_acsr(size,amb=40): return ACSR_AMP[size][str(amb)]

# ============================================================ cable sizing (size,sets,ampacity_per_set)
def size_cable(item_id, ampfn, scsize):
    I=ITEMS[item_id]['I']; best=None
    for sets in range(1,5):
        for si in range(ORDER.index(scsize),len(ORDER)):
            s=ORDER[si]; amp=ampfn(s,sets)
            if amp is None: continue
            if sets*amp>=I:
                key=sets*CABLE[s][2]
                if best is None or key<best[0]: best=(key,(s,sets,amp))
    if best is None:
        s='1000'; return s,3,ampfn(s,3)
    return best[1]

# ============================================================ routes (recommended)
def S(method,pts,cover=24,rows=1,cols=1,ductsize='EB20-5',spares=1,reinforced=False,paved=False,shared=None):
    return dict(method=method,pts=pts,cover=cover,rows=rows,cols=cols,ductsize=ductsize,
                spares=spares,reinforced=reinforced,paved=paved,shared=shared or set())
def spares_rule(n_occ):
    # UFC 3-550-01 3-11.2.2: at least 1/3 of ductbank empty (spares/(occ+spares)>=1/3), min 1
    s=1
    while s/(n_occ+s) < 1.0/3.0: s+=1
    return s

# proto-route legs: (method, pts, cover, ductsize) -- cols set after sizing
LEGS={
 'C01':[('CE',[(280,640),(340,640),(340,620),(710,620)],24,'EB20-5'),('HDD',[(710,620),(840,620)],48,'HDPE-5'),('CE',[(840,620),(1090,620)],24,'EB20-5'),('CE',[(1090,620),(1090,730),(1100,730)],24,'EB20-5')],
 'C02':[('CE',[(280,520),(340,520),(340,545),(710,545)],24,'EB20-5'),('HDD',[(710,545),(840,545)],48,'HDPE-5'),('CE',[(840,545),(840,445)],24,'EB20-5'),('CE',[(840,445),(840,415)],54,'EB20-5'),('CE',[(840,415),(1330,420)],24,'EB20-5')],
 'C03':[('CE',[(240,700),(470,700)],24,'EB20-5'),('CE',[(470,700),(470,895)],24,'EB20-5'),('CE',[(470,895),(470,945)],52,'EB20-5'),('CE',[(470,945),(470,960)],24,'EB20-5')],
 'C04':[('CE',[(600,1020),(620,1020),(620,1000),(1550,1000)],24,'EB20-5'),('HDD',[(1550,1000),(1690,1000)],120,'HDPE-5'),('CE',[(1690,1000),(1690,1152),(1760,1152)],24,'EB20-5')],
 'C06':[('CE',[(180,480),(195,480),(195,110),(710,110)],24,'EB20-5'),('HDD',[(710,110),(840,110)],48,'HDPE-5'),('CE',[(840,110),(1800,110),(1800,122)],24,'EB20-5')],
 'C07':[('CE',[(470,1060),(470,1075),(710,1075)],24,'EB20-5'),('HDD',[(710,1075),(840,1075)],48,'HDPE-5'),('CE',[(840,1075),(1030,1075),(1030,1172)],24,'EB20-5')],
}
def build_segs(iid,sets):
    out=[]
    for m,pts,cover,ds in LEGS[iid]:
        if m in ('CE','UE'):
            out.append(S(m,pts,cover=cover,cols=sets+spares_rule(sets),ductsize=ds,spares=spares_rule(sets)))
        elif m=='HDD':
            out.append(S(m,pts,cover=cover,cols=sets,ductsize=ds,spares=0))
        else:
            out.append(S(m,pts,cover=cover,cols=sets,ductsize=ds))
    return out
def gov_amp(iid,size,sets):
    info=ITEMS[iid]; legs=LEGS[iid]
    ug=sum(plen(p) for m,p,c,d in legs if m in('CE','UE','DB','HDD','JB','JS'))
    bore=sum(plen(p) for m,p,c,d in legs if m in('HDD','JB','JS'))
    amps=[]
    for m,p,c,d in legs:
        mx=(p[0][0]+p[-1][0])/2; my=(p[0][1]+p[-1][1])/2
        b=nearest_boring(mx,my); rho=next_rho(boring_rho(b))
        if m in('CE','UE'): amp=amp_ductbank(size,sets,rho,info['lf'],c,25)
        elif m in('HDD','JB','JS'):
            if (bore/ug if ug else 1)<=0.25: continue
            amp=amp_single(size,rho,c,info['lf'],25)
        else: amp=None
        if amp: amps.append(amp)
    return min(amps) if amps else None

ROUTES={
 'C01':('CEDB',None),'C02':('CEDB',None),'C03':('CEDB',None),'C04':('CEDB',None),
 'C05':('RMC',[dict(method='RMC',pts=[(1132,732),(1132,705),(1442,705),(1442,642)],riser=7,bends=2,firewalls=2)]),
 'C06':('CEDB',None),'C07':('CEDB',None),
}
# OH route for C06: ug riser at SS-1 (x195 avoid T-208 TPZ), OH east along y=290 (non-congested) crossing Mission Dr (50ft poles), over channel DC-1, ug riser to TX-GH1
C06_OH=dict(
  ug=[S('CE',[(180,480),(195,480),(195,298)],cols=2),S('CE',[(1800,150),(1800,122)],cols=2)],
  oh_pts=[(195,298),(495,290),(745,290),(815,290),(1115,290),(1415,290),(1560,290),(1690,290),(1800,150)],
  poles=[(195,298),(495,290),(745,290),(815,290),(1115,290),(1415,290),(1560,290),(1690,290),(1800,150)],
  riser=[(195,298),(1800,150)],
  pole_50_idx=[2,3],  # indices into poles list that are 50ft (Mission Dr crossing span)
  guys=3, xarms=11,  # 9 poles +2 dead-ends; guys: P1 riser, P8 deflection 52deg, P9 riser
  conductor='ACSR-1/0')

# ============================================================ manhole placement (auto)
PAVE_RECTS=[(0,60,1900,90),(760,90,790,1300),(790,822,1100,846),(300,760,640,900),(600,930,700,1060)]
BLDG_RECTS=[(80,480,280,700),(1100,420,1500,820),(420,960,600,1060),(700,1150,1000,1260),(1830,100,1870,140),(1790,1170,1830,1210)]
CHAN=(1575,275,1665,1300)
RAILBAND=(0,1085.6,1000,1114.4)
TREES_RET=[(520,655,20),(245,820,16),(900,1030,18),(650,1118,12),(600,520,16),(1070,700,12),(1300,900,22)]
def mh_ok(x,y):
    for (x0,y0,x1,y1) in PAVE_RECTS+BLDG_RECTS:
        if x0<=x<=x1 and y0<=y<=y1: return False
    if CHAN[0]<=x<=CHAN[2] and CHAN[1]<=y<=CHAN[3]: return False
    if RAILBAND[0]<=x<=RAILBAND[2] and RAILBAND[1]<=y<=RAILBAND[3]: return False
    for (tx,ty,r) in TREES_RET:
        if (tx-x)**2+(ty-y)**2 < (r+4)**2: return False   # 4ft working room beyond TPZ
    return True
def place_manholes(item_id, segs):
    """Place manholes: first<=180ft from source, last<=180ft from dest, spacing<=380ft,
    avoiding pavement, buildings, channel buffer, rail band and tree protection zones."""
    pts=[]
    for s in segs:
        if s['method'] in ('CE','UE','DB','HDD','JB','JS'):
            for p in s['pts']:
                if not pts or p!=pts[-1]: pts.append(p)
    if not pts: return []
    L=plen(pts)
    def pos_at(d):
        acc=0
        for i in range(len(pts)-1):
            segL=dist(pts[i],pts[i+1])
            if acc+segL>=d:
                t=(d-acc)/segL
                return (pts[i][0]+t*(pts[i+1][0]-pts[i][0]), pts[i][1]+t*(pts[i+1][1]-pts[i][1]))
            acc+=segL
        return pts[-1]
    positions=[]
    first=150; last=180; spacing=380
    d=first
    while d<L-last:
        p=pos_at(d)
        if not mh_ok(*p):
            # walk back to a valid position
            dd=d; ok=False
            while dd>1:
                dd-=5; q=pos_at(dd)
                if mh_ok(*q): p=q; ok=True; break
            if not ok:
                dd=d
                while dd<L-1:
                    dd+=5; q=pos_at(dd)
                    if mh_ok(*q): p=q; ok=True; break
            if not ok:
                d+=spacing; continue
        # avoid duplicates/too-close
        if positions and dist(positions[-1],p)<60:
            d+=spacing; continue
        positions.append(p)
        d+=spacing
    return positions

# ============================================================ takeoff engine (site)
def add(rows, code, qty, matcode=None, sub=0):
    if code in LU:
        mh,crew=lu_mh(code, large_string=(code=='STRING'))
    else:
        mh,crew=0.0,None
    mhr=mh*qty
    if crew:
        crate=crew_avg_rate(crew); cer=crew_eq_rate(crew); csize=CREWS[crew][0]
        lab=mhr*crate; eq=(mhr/csize)*cer if csize else 0
        unit=LU[code][1]
    else:
        lab=0; eq=0; unit=MAT[code][1] if code in MAT else 'EA'
    mat=mat_unit(matcode)*qty if (matcode and qty and qty>0) else 0
    rows.append([code,qty,unit,mhr,lab,eq,mat,sub])

def takeoff_site(item_id, ctype, segs, size, sets, oh=None, n_mh=None):
    info=ITEMS[item_id]; rows=[]
    ug_len=sum(plen(s['pts']) for s in segs if s['method'] in ('CE','UE','DB','HDD','JB','JS'))
    n_equip=2
    for s in segs:
        L=plen(s['pts']); m=s['method']; cols=s['cols']; rows_n=s['rows']; ducts=cols*rows_n
        od=COND[s['ductsize']][0]
        if m in ('CE','UE'):
            ew=cols*od+(cols-1)*3+(6 if m=='CE' else 0)
            eh=rows_n*od+(rows_n-1)*3+(6 if m=='CE' else 0)
            botw=ew+12; dep_in=s['cover']+eh+3; dep_ft=dep_in/12.0
            b=nearest_boring(*midpt(s)); st=soil_type(b,dep_ft); sl=SLOPE[st]
            # protective system: trench shield (box) for >=5ft (narrower than sloping); TBOX applies
            if dep_ft>=5:
                exc_cf=(botw/12.0)*dep_ft*L; prot='box'; boxlen=L
            else:
                exc_cf=(botw/12.0)*dep_ft*L; prot='none'; boxlen=0
            add(rows,'EX-MACH',exc_cf/27.0)
            duct_area=ducts*(math.pi/4.0)*(od/12.0)**2*L
            env_cf=(ew/12.0)*(eh/12.0)*L
            if m=='CE':
                conc_cy=(env_cf-duct_area)/27.0
                add(rows,'CONC-PL',conc_cy,'CONC-3000')
                bf=exc_cf/27.0-env_cf/27.0
            else:
                # UE: sand = trench bottom width x (envelope height + 6 + 3) - envelope(bounding box); backfill = exc - envelope - sand
                sand_cf=(botw/12.0)*((eh+9)/12.0)*L - env_cf
                add(rows,'SAND-BED',sand_cf/27.0,'SAND')
                bf=exc_cf/27.0-env_cf/27.0-sand_cf/27.0
            if bf>0: add(rows,'BF-COMP',bf)
            matcode='EB20-5' if s['ductsize']=='HDPE-5' else s['ductsize']
            add(rows,'DUCT-CE' if m=='CE' else 'DUCT-UE', ducts*L, matcode)
            add(rows,'SPACER', ducts*(int(L//5)+1),'SPACER')
            if boxlen>0: add(rows,'TBOX',boxlen)
            if m=='CE' and s['reinforced']:
                nb=6 if ew>30 else 4
                rebar=nb*0.668*L+(int(L//3)+1)*((2*(ew-3)+2*(eh-3))/12.0)*0.376
                add(rows,'REBAR',rebar,'REBAR-4')
            add(rows,'GND-DB',L,'GND-4/0'); add(rows,'TAPE',L,'TAPE-DET')
            if s['paved']:
                topw=botw+(2*sl*dep_in if prot=='slope' else 0)
                add(rows,'PAVE-CUT',L*(topw/12.0+2)/9.0,'ASPHALT')
            gwt=boring_gw_ft(b)
            if dep_ft>gwt and gwt<15: add(rows,'DEWATER',L)
        elif m=='DB':
            ch=2.155*CABLE[size][0]; botw=8; dep_in=s['cover']+ch+3; dep_ft=dep_in/12.0
            b=nearest_boring(*midpt(s)); st=soil_type(b,dep_ft); sl=SLOPE[st]
            add(rows,'EX-TRCH',L)
            sand_cf=(botw/12.0)*((ch+6)/12.0)*L
            add(rows,'SAND-BED',sand_cf/27.0,'SAND')
            exc_cf=(botw/12.0)*dep_ft*L   # trench box keeps narrow width
            bf=exc_cf/27.0-sand_cf/27.0
            if bf>0: add(rows,'BF-COMP',bf)
            if dep_ft>=5: add(rows,'TBOX',L)
            add(rows,'GND-DB',L,'GND-4/0'); add(rows,'TAPE',L,'TAPE-DET')
            gwt=boring_gw_ft(b)
            if dep_ft>gwt and gwt<15: add(rows,'DEWATER',L)
        elif m=='HDD':
            ncond=cols*s['rows']; per={2:64.0,4:92.0,6:128.0}.get(ncond,128.0)
            ft=per*L; sub=ft+5400.0
            if s['cover']>96: sub+=0.15*ft
            sub=max(sub,14000.0)
            rows.append(['SUB-HDD',1,'EA',0,0,0,0,sub])
        elif m=='JB':
            ncond=cols*s['rows']; sub=295.0*L+(ncond-1)*88.0*L+6800.0
            rows.append(['SUB-JB',1,'EA',0,0,0,0,sub])
            rows.append(['RGS-5',ncond*L,'LF',0,0,0,mat_unit('RGS-5')*ncond*L,0])
        elif m=='JS':
            ncond=cols*s['rows']; sub=540.0*L+ncond*36.0*L+9800.0
            rows.append(['SUB-JS',1,'EA',0,0,0,0,sub])
            rows.append(['RGS-5',ncond*L,'LF',0,0,0,mat_unit('RGS-5')*ncond*L,0])
    # manholes
    if n_mh is None: n_mh=len(place_manholes(item_id,segs))
    for _ in range(n_mh):
        bw=7.33+4; bl=9.33+4; exc_cy=bw*bl*8/27.0
        add(rows,'EX-MACH',exc_cy)
        rock=bw*bl*0.5/27.0; add(rows,'MH-BASE',rock,'ROCK-BASE')
        bf=exc_cy-(7.33*9.33*7)/27.0-rock
        if bf>0: add(rows,'BF-COMP',bf)
        add(rows,'MH-SET',1,'MH-PRECAST'); add(rows,'TBOX',20)
    # cable: circuit-ft = sets x (UG route + 6/mh + 18/equip terminal + 40/riser pole)
    n_riser=len(oh['riser']) if oh else 0
    ckt=sets*(ug_len+6*n_mh+18*n_equip+40*n_riser)
    pullcode='PULL-MV-L' if kcmil(size)>=250 else 'PULL-MV'
    if ctype=='DBC':

        add(rows,'DBC-LAY',sets*(dbl+6*n_mh+18*n_equip+40*n_riser))

        best=0;bd=1e18;acc=0

            x1,y1=pts[i]; x2,y2=pts[i+1]; dx=x2-x1;dy=y2-y1;Ls=math.hypot(dx,dy)

            t=max(0,min(1,((pt[0]-x1)*dx+(pt[1]-y1)*dy)/(Ls*Ls)))
            px=x1+t*dx;py=y1+t*dy;d=math.hypot(px-pt[0],py-pt[1])

    stations=[150.0]

            if not ok:
                dd=s
                while dd<L-50:
                    dd+=5; q=pos_at(dd)
                    if mh_ok(*q): p=q; ok=True; break
            if not ok: continue
        ps=station_of(p)
        if positions and (ps-last_st)<60: continue
        if (L-ps)<50: continue
        positions.append(p); last_st=ps

def mh_ok(x,y):

def place_manholes(item_id, segs):
    """Place manholes: first<=200ft from source, last<=200ft from dest, spacing<=400ft,
    avoiding pavement, buildings, channel buffer, rail band and tree protection zones (3-11.6)."""
    pts=[]
    for s in segs:
        if s['method'] in ('CE','UE','DB','HDD','JB','JS'):
            for p in s['pts']:
                if not pts or p!=pts[-1]: pts.append(p)
    if not pts: return []
    L=plen(pts)
    def pos_at(d):
        acc=0
        for i in range(len(pts)-1):
            segL=dist(pts[i],pts[i+1])
            if acc+segL>=d:
                t=(d-acc)/segL
                return (pts[i][0]+t*(pts[i+1][0]-pts[i][0]), pts[i][1]+t*(pts[i+1][1]-pts[i][1]))
            acc+=segL
        return pts[-1]
    def station_of(pt):
        best=0;bd=1e18;acc=0
        for i in range(len(pts)-1):
            x1,y1=pts[i]; x2,y2=pts[i+1]; dx=x2-x1;dy=y2-y1;Ls=math.hypot(dx,dy)
            if Ls==0: continue
            t=max(0,min(1,((pt[0]-x1)*dx+(pt[1]-y1)*dy)/(Ls*Ls)))
            px=x1+t*dx;py=y1+t*dy;d=math.hypot(px-pt[0],py-pt[1])
            if d<bd:bd=d;best=acc+t*Ls
            acc+=Ls
        return best
    # candidate stations: first at 150, then every 380, and one at L-150 if last too far
    stations=[150.0]
    d=150.0
    while d < L-380:
        d+=380
        if d < L-150: stations.append(float(d))
    if L - stations[-1] > 200:
        stations.append(L-150.0)
    # ensure monotonic & within bounds
    stations=sorted(set(s for s in stations if 50 < s < L-50))
    positions=[]
    last_st=0
    for s in stations:
        p=pos_at(s)
        if not mh_ok(*p):
            dd=s; ok=False
            while dd>last_st+60:
                dd-=5; q=pos_at(dd)
                if mh_ok(*q): p=q; ok=True; break
            if not ok:
                dd=s
                while dd<L-50:
                    dd+=5; q=pos_at(dd)
                    if mh_ok(*q): p=q; ok=True; break
            if not ok: continue
        ps=station_of(p)
        if positions and (ps-last_st)<60: continue
        if (L-ps)<50: continue
        positions.append(p); last_st=ps
    # final guard: ensure last position within 200 of end; if not, that's acceptable only if <=200; else insert
    return positions

    # tabulated (Oct 1 each year): 2024->1.0, 2025->1.021, 2026->1.042441, 2027->1.064332261
    import datetime
    tabs=[(datetime.date(2024,10,1),1.0),(datetime.date(2025,10,1),1.021),
          (datetime.date(2026,10,1),1.042441),(datetime.date(2027,10,1),1.064332261)]
    d=datetime.date(int(date[:4]),int(date[5:7]),int(date[8:10]))
    for i in range(len(tabs)-1):
        d0,f0=tabs[i]; d1,f1=tabs[i+1]
        if d0<=d<=d1:
            frac=(d-d0).days/(d1-d0).days
            return f0+frac*(f1-f0)
    if d<tabs[0][0]: return tabs[0][1]
    return tabs[-1][1]

    for v in [60,90,120,150]:

    gw_ft = BORINGS[b][3]/12.0

        acc=0
